name: linkedin-job-signals
description: Plain LinkedIn, no Sales Navigator needed. Find companies hiring for roles that signal a need for what you sell, from LinkedIn job postings: reads LinkedIn's public job pages (no sign-in, paced, capped), reads the posts, qualifies each company against your profile, and writes a full CSV plus an Apollo-ready account CSV with buyer titles and a one-line opener per company. Read-only. Runs on your own machine.
